name.value: Sunny Chibas Fried Chicken Mexican Cantina

description.value: Sunny Chibas Fried Chicken Mexican Cantina is a Mexican cantina on the Sea to Sky Highway in Squamish offering a fusion of fried chicken and Mexican food. It sits along one of BC's most iconic cycling routes, making it a potential stop for riders travelling the Sea to Sky corridor. Outdoor seating is listed in OSM, which would suit cyclists looking to eat al fresco after a long climb.
